VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoIntro: I trained together with my whole family, every one of us! I'm not losing to anyone!
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoDefeat: Better than my family?! Is that possible?!
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoPostBattle:
I was better than everyone in my family. I've never lost before…
I've lost my confidence… Maybe I'll go home…
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenIntro: I'd heard that there was a tough little kid around. Do they mean you?
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenPostBattle: The rumors I heard, that tough little kid is from PETALBURG CITY.
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolineIntro: You must be getting a little tired.
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolineDefeat: No signs of tiring at all!
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolinePostBattle: VICTORY ROAD and the POKéMON LEAGUE are long and grueling challenges. Beware of fatigue!
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JulieIntro:
You shouldn't get complacent just because you have a lot of GYM BADGES.
There's always going to be someone who's better than you!
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JuliePostBattle: Gaze on your collected BADGES and remember the TRAINERS you've faced.
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixIntro: I've come this far, but the tension's giving me awful stomach pain…
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixPostBattle:
I can't help getting all tense knowing that I'm nearing the POKéMON LEAGUE.
It's all I can do to feign calm.
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DianneIntro:
The elite among the elite gather in this cave.
How are you finding it?
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DianneDefeat: Not rattled in the least bit!
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DiannePostBattle: You do have guts! I like that! Keep it going!
